newsitem.title: TURKEY: Greek coastguard fires at Turk boat, one dead.
newsitem.headline: Greek coastguard fires at Turk boat, one dead.

text.p: A Greek coastguard vessel opened fire on a Turkish speed boat, killing a fisherman on board who had smuggled a group of Iraqi illegal immigrants to a Greek island, Anatolian news agency said on Monday.

The Turkish agency said the Greek vessel fired on the boat on Sunday evening after it had ignored warning shots and tried to escape. Another Turkish fisherman in the speedboat was wounded, Anatolian said.
The Greek embassy said it had no information on the shooting.
The boat was returning to Turkey after leaving seven Iraqis on the small Greek island of Pharmakos, Anatolian said. It did not say in whose territorial waters the incident occurred.
Turkish police were questioning the wounded fisherman on charges of smuggling and border violations, the agency said.
NATO allies Turkey and Greece have long been at odds over territorial disputes in the Aegean Sea, as well as minority rights and the divided island of Cyprus.
They came close to conflict in January over uninhabited islets in the Aegean in a tense military standoff that was overcome through U.S. mediation.
